title: Charlie's Movie Preferences
shared_passage:
Listen to Charlie talking about different kinds of movies. Choose the statement that is NOT true about each kind of film.

Well, I guess my favourite kind of movie is sci-fi. If I'm at home in the evening, and I want to watch a film, that's the first kind of film I will look for. I think those films are imaginative and interesting. However, there are some terrible sci-fi films out there! But even the terrible ones are funny, sometimes!

Rom-coms, uurgh no. I don't watch those unless I have to. My girlfriend loves them and sometimes I watch them if we are having a romantic evening at home. But they are so boring and predictable. The characters are always the same. They are rarely funny.

I like horror films, though. They are predictable, I know, but I just enjoy them. I often watch them with friends and we try to guess what is going to happen, so it's always sociable. It's also interesting to discuss how they did the special effects and horrible make-up. I used to think horror films were scary, but now I don't.

I love animated films too. All kinds, from Japanese anime to children's cartoons. I think the Japanese style films are really beautiful, creative and imaginative. The stories are strange, but the artwork is beautiful. And some children's cartoons are really funny. I watch them with my little cousin. There is something for everyone, kids and adults.

I used to love action films, but I don't think modern action films are as good as the ones in the past. Before, they were big-budget, blockbuster films. They were set in amazing locations and the stunts were incredible. Now they are often low-budget with lots of computer graphics. They just aren't as exciting.

I don't often watch documentaries. I suppose in the evenings, I don't want to learn. I want to relax. And many documentaries are depressing. They tell you about all the things that are bad in the world. It's important information, but those kinds of films aren't very enjoyable.

And musicals! I hate them! I can't understand why people are talking and then they start singing! Of course, musicals aren't very popular now, like they were in the past, and that's a good thing! My girlfriend loves them, but luckily, she prefers to watch them with her friends and they sing along together. I don't have to watch!
